description: Query the root-cause graph to trace upstream failure sources (`diagnose`), downstream blast radius (`intervene`), simulated interventions (`do_calculus`, `counterfactual`), continuous-metric what-if estimation (`continuous_counterfactual`, separating hidden disturbance from action effect with identifiability and discontinuity guards), or highest-value diagnostic checks (`experiments`). Use to analyze recorded dependencies; call `oxyo_causal_record` to add new edges.

action_distance.description: Optional distance between factual and alternative actions for error-bound reporting.

alt_pred.description: Baseline predicted numeric outcome under the alternative action for 'continuous_counterfactual'.

do.description: Optional forced node state map {node: 0.0..1.0} for 'do_calculus' or 'counterfactual'.

entity.description: Target symptom (for 'diagnose') or upstream node (for 'intervene') to analyze.

factual.description: Optional observed node state map {node: 0.0..1.0} for 'counterfactual' queries.

factual_pred.description: Baseline predicted numeric outcome under the factual action for 'continuous_counterfactual'.

has_discontinuity.description: Set true if the transition crossed a sharp jump or discrete regime break.

horizon.description: Optional transition duration horizon for short-time error-scale reporting.

is_multiplicative.description: Set true if the unobserved disturbance scales/multiplies the action rather than acting additively.

max_hops.description: Maximum multi-hop traversal depth across the causal graph (1..8).

observed_outcome.description: Observed factual numeric scalar or vector outcome for 'continuous_counterfactual'.

persistent_disturbance.description: Whether the unobserved disturbance persists for the counterfactual event (default true).

name: oxyo_causal_infer
